This module contains the in-memory repository model, REST handlers and REST route definitions from the [Mirage integration server](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/3e0c6d500bddd2be028e4ceaa5439604ed4fb9c4/integ/server/github_server.py). The vendored excerpt ends after `_add_routes` and omits the host fixture reset method. VFS-Bench seeds the service directly and registers the trial-facing GitHub routes. The Apache-2.0 license accompanies the source.
